children: South Korean labour union approved a tentative wage agreement with the automaker, bringing an end to this year's pay negotiations after weeks of strikes and talks.
Some 61.55% of participating union members voted in favour of the agreement, Yonhap News Agency said on Tuesday.
A representative of the union could not be immediately reached.
